SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUMNOTA, ITE.CODCFO AS CODCFO, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.CODTIPOPER, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.VLRNOTA, CAB.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, CAB.CODCENCUS, CUS.DESCRCENCUS, NAT.CODCTACTB,
NVL(( SELECT PLA.DESCRCTA FROM TCBPLA PLA WHERE PLA.CODCTACTB = NVL(NAT.CODCTACTB, 0) ),'SEM CONTA') AS DESC_CONTA, (SELECT PLA.CTACTB FROM TCBPLA PLA WHERE PLA.CODCTACTB = NVL(NAT.CODCTACTB, 0)) AS EFD_CONTA, MAX(ITE.CODTRIB) AS CST_ICMS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END) AS BASEICMS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS ICMS, MAX(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END) AS CST_PIS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END) AS BASEPIS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS PIS, MAX(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END) AS CST_COFINS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END) AS BASECOFINS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS COFINS, CAB2.NUNOTA AS NUNOTAVINCULADO, MAX_NCT.NUMERO AS NUMERO, CAB2.CHAVENFE, CAB2.CODTIPOPER AS TOPVINCULADA, MAX((SELECT T.DESCROPER FROM TGFTOP T WHERE T.CODTIPOPER = CAB2.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = CAB2.DHTIPOPER)) AS TPO, CASE WHEN (CAB.CODTIPOPER = 225 AND CAB2.CODTIPOPER IN (214,1125,305)) OR (CAB.CODTIPOPER = 226 AND CAB2.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,1117,1126,1200,2200,2202)) OR (CAB.CODTIPOPER = 234 AND CAB2.CODTIPOPER IN (201)) THEN 'SIM' WHEN CAB.CODTIPOPER = 242 AND CAB2.CODTIPOPER IN (201,267,231,1266,1267,1327) THEN 'NÃO' ELSE 'VERIFICAR' END AS VALIDADOR, CASE WHEN CAB2.VLRFRETE > 0 THEN CAB2.VLRFRETE ELSE CAB2.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE END AS VLRFRETEVINCULADO FROM TGFCAB CAB
INNER JOIN TGFTOP TPO ON TPO.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TPO.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFDIN DIN ON DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = CAB.CODNAT
INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC
INNER JOIN TSICUS CUS ON CUS.CODCENCUS = CAB.CODCENCUS
INNER JOIN ( SELECT NUNOTA, MAX(NUMERO) AS NUMERO, MAX(CHAVENFE) AS MAX_CAMPO FROM TGFNCT GROUP BY NUNOTA ) MAX_NCT ON CAB.NUNOTA = MAX_NCT.NUNOTA
LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB2 ON CAB2.CHAVENFE = MAX_NCT.MAX_CAMPO
LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR2 ON CAB2.CODPARC = PAR2.CODPARC
LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR3 ON CAB2.CODPARCTRANSP = PAR3.CODPARC
WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (225,226,234,242)
AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) BETWEEN :P_PRAZO.INI AND :P_PRAZO.FIN AND (:P_CODPARC1 IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC1) AND (:P_NUMNOTA IS NULL OR CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA) AND (:P_NUMNOTAVINCULADA IS NULL OR CAB2.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTAVINCULADA) GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUMNOTA, ITE.CODCFO, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.CODTIPOPER, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.VLRNOTA, CAB.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, CAB.CODCENCUS, CUS.DESCRCENCUS, NAT.CODCTACTB, CAB2.NUNOTA, CAB2.CHAVENFE, CAB2.CODTIPOPER, CAB2.VLRFRETE, CAB2.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE, MAX_NCT.NUMERO
UNION ALL /***************************************CTE SEM VINCULACAO*************************************************/
SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUMNOTA, ITE.CODCFO AS CODCFO, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.CODTIPOPER, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.VLRNOTA, CAB.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, CAB.CODCENCUS, CUS.DESCRCENCUS, NAT.CODCTACTB, NVL(( SELECT PLA.DESCRCTA FROM TCBPLA PLA WHERE PLA.CODCTACTB = NVL(NAT.CODCTACTB, 0) ),'SEM CONTA') AS DESC_CONTA, (SELECT PLA.CTACTB FROM TCBPLA PLA WHERE PLA.CODCTACTB = NVL(NAT.CODCTACTB, 0)) AS EFD_CONTA, MAX(ITE.CODTRIB) AS CST_ICMS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END) AS BASEICMS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS ICMS, MAX(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END) AS CST_PIS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END) AS BASEPIS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS PIS, MAX(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.CST ELSE 0 END) AS CST_COFINS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END) AS BASECOFINS, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 7 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS COFINS, TO_NUMBER(0) AS NUNOTAVINCULADO, TO_CHAR(0) AS NUMERO, CAB.CHAVENFE AS CHAVENFE, 0 AS TOPVINCULADA, TO_CHAR('SEM TOP') AS TPO, 'NÃO' AS VALIDADOR, 0 AS VLRFRETEVINCULADO FROM TGFCAB CAB
INNER JOIN TGFTOP TPO ON TPO.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TPO.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFDIN DIN ON DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = CAB.CODNAT
INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC
INNER JOIN TSICUS CUS ON CUS.CODCENCUS = CAB.CODCENCUS
WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (225,226,234,242)
AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) BETWEEN :P_PRAZO.INI AND :P_PRAZO.FIN AND (:P_CODPARC1 IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC1) AND (:P_NUMNOTA IS NULL OR CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA) AND (:P_NUMNOTAVINCULADA IS NULL OR CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTAVINCULADA) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFNCT NCT WHERE NCT.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA ) GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUMNOTA, ITE.CODCFO, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.CODTIPOPER, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.VLRNOTA, CAB.CODNAT, NAT.DESCRNAT, CAB.CODCENCUS, CUS.DESCRCENCUS, NAT.CODCTACTB, CAB.CHAVENFE
